title: Copilot Dashboard: Copilot configuration recommendations on the Readiness page
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing and dashboard access controls are supported. However, it incorrectly says Contact admin sends requests and that viewers can email administrators in two clicks: Microsoft documents viewing contact details and opening email software, not sending a message.

claims.fix: Replace the Change & support bullet with 'Contact admin displays administrator details; Send email opens the viewer's email software with the selected admins' aliases prefilled in the To line.' In Why it matters, replace 'email the Global admins about it in two clicks' with 'open their email software with selected admins' aliases prefilled using Contact admin and Send email'. These are the documented actions at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/org-team-insights/copilot-dashboard#readiness; neither sends a message.
